selector.rationale: The presence of osteolytic lesions and subepidermal infiltrate with CD1A positivity supports Langerhans cell histiocytosis, but the lack of systemic involvement beyond the scalp and skull suggests a more localized form.

rejected.label: Multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: No significant systemic involvement or multi-organ dysfunction was noted.
